statement: Web Annotation is intentionally capable of rich graph-shaped annotation while permitting performant non-graph implementations.
actakit_implication: Keep ActaKit graph-shaped but relational; no graph DB baseline.

statement: Evidence targeting should separate the resource from the selector that identifies the exact segment and, when needed, the state/version of that resource.
actakit_implication: Refine EvidenceLink into representation + typed selector bundle + state anchor.

statement: Redundant selectors can make a citation more durable than one coordinate system alone.
actakit_implication: For text/PDF, allow exact quote plus structural/page/offset context instead of one brittle locator.

statement: TextQuoteSelector and TextPositionSelector solve different durability problems and can be combined/refined.
actakit_implication: EvidenceLocator should allow typed redundant selectors rather than one universal coordinate field.

statement: The annotation model is interoperable without requiring a graph-database storage topology.
actakit_implication: Represent connected evidence relationally; interoperability belongs at boundaries, not in storage technology.
